import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from fin_skills.algorithms import positions, adjust_prices

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices using the cumulative split factors
    adjusted_prices = adjust_prices(prices, split_factors)
    
    # Compute the 5-day and 20-day rolling means
    mean_5 = adjusted_prices.rolling(window=5).mean()
    mean_20 = adjusted_prices.rolling(window=20).mean()
    
    # Compute the signal: sign(mean_5 - mean_20)
    signal = np.sign(mean_5 - mean_20)
    
    # Divide the signal by 4 to get the weights
    weights = signal / 4
    
    # Set warm-up rows to 0
    weights.iloc[:20] = 0
    
    # Apply the execution lag by shifting the positions down one row
    weights = weights.shift(1)
    
    # Ensure no nonfinite values in the weights
    weights = weights.fillna(0).clip(lower=-np.inf, upper=np.inf)
    
    return weights
